items.title: Gold price in Pakistan rises Rs4,700 per tola
items.summary: Gold price in Pakistan increased on Friday, with 24-karat gold being sold at Rs453,036 per tola, up Rs4,700.

items.title: Why record reserves are not worth celebrating yet
items.summary: Pakistan's central bank has never held this many dollars. On September 18, the State Bank's reserves stood at $21.40 billion, comfortably above the previous peak of $20.07 billion set in August 2021. It is a genuine milestone. It is also a slightly misleading one, because almost none of that money was earned.

items.title: PKR extends gains, closes at 277.16 against USD
items.summary: The Pakistani rupee (PKR) edged higher against the US dollar on Friday, appreciating by 1.17 paisa in the interbank market to close at PKR 277.16 per dollar, compared with the previous session’s close of PKR 277.17.
